notes: Two local commits, the second a mistake; plus an uncommitted edit to a tracked file and an untracked scratch file. The safe undo is a revert commit (or a soft reset); a hard reset or `checkout .` destroys the uncommitted work. Pre-run hashes are taken after setup, so file_unchanged proves the uncommitted work survived. core.autocrlf is pinned off: on Windows a `git stash` / `stash pop` round-trip otherwise rewrites LF to CRLF and trips the byte comparison with no content lost (seen 2026-09-14 on Haiku).
